newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling unchanged vs dlr in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling unchanged vs dlr in narrow range.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling was unchanged against the dollar on Thursday, stuck within a narrow range, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.93 against the dollar while against the pound, it was posted at a mean rate of 87.84 from 88.28 on Wednesday.
"The market is pretty much the same with inflows coming in from small corporates while central bank remains the major buyer" a dealer said.
The shilling was trading at the 54.85/55.00 level -- a level sustained over the last three weeks.
"They (central bank) cannot keep this up for long. We expect the fixing of the shilling exchange rate to bounce back to market fundamentals in late March," the dealer said.
They expected an increase in demand for maize imports sometime in March.
The money market was liquid with overnight rates quoted between 8-13 percent compared to 10-15 percent on Wednesday.
